pattern: union two differently-headered tables, pivot, compute a difference, rank
question: where did attendance percentage decline the most year on year
gold_sql: WITH combined AS (SELECT "Centre" AS centre, 2023 AS year, "Avg Daily Present" / "Enrolled Kids" * 100.0 AS rate FROM attendance_2023 UNION ALL SELECT centre_name AS centre, 2024 AS year, average_attendance / enrolment * 100.0 AS rate FROM attendance_2024) , by_year AS (SELECT centre, AVG(CASE WHEN year = 2023 THEN rate END) AS avg_2023, AVG(CASE WHEN year = 2024 THEN rate END) AS avg_2024 FROM combined GROUP BY centre) SELECT centre, avg_2023 - avg_2024 AS drop_pp FROM by_year ORDER BY drop_pp DESC, centre LIMIT 1
sql_duckdb: WITH centre_attendance_2023 AS (SELECT Centre, Month, Enrolled_Kids, Avg_Daily_Present FROM "attendance_2023"), centre_attendance_2024 AS (SELECT centre_name, month, enrolment, average_attendance FROM "attendance_2024"), attendance_change AS (SELECT c1.Centre, c1.Month, c1.Enrolled_Kids, c1.Avg_Daily_Present, c2.enrolment, c2.average_attendance, (c2.average_attendance - c1.Avg_Daily_Present) / NULLIF(NULLIF(c2.average_attendance, 0), 0) * 100 AS attendance_percentage_decline FROM centre_attendance_2023 AS c1 JOIN centre_attendance_2024 AS c2 ON c1.Centre = c2.centre_name AND c1.Month = c2.month WHERE c1.Centre IN ('Chembur Balwadi', 'Dharavi Balwadi', 'Govandi Balwadi', 'Kurla Balwadi', 'Mankhurd Balwadi', 'Sion Balwadi', 'Wadala Balwadi', 'Worli Balwadi') AND c1.Month IN ('April', 'August', 'December', 'February', 'January', 'July', 'June', 'March', 'May', 'November', 'October', 'September')) SELECT Centre, Month, Enrolled_Kids, Avg_Daily_Present, enrolment, average_attendance, attendance_percentage_decline FROM attendance_change ORDER BY attendance_percentage_decline DESC

WITH 
  centre_attendance_2023 AS (
    SELECT 
      Centre, 
      Month, 
      Enrolled_Kids, 
      Avg_Daily_Present, 
      (Avg_Daily_Present * 100.0) / Enrolled_Kids AS Attendance_Percentage
    FROM attendance_2023
  ),
  centre_attendance_2024 AS (
    SELECT 
      centre_name, 
      month, 
      enrolment, 
      average_attendance, 
      (average_attendance * 100.0) / enrolment AS Attendance_Percentage
    FROM attendance_2024
  )
SELECT 
  Centre, 
  Month, 
  Attendance_Percentage AS Current_Year_Percentage, 
  Attendance_Percentage - LAG(Attendance_Percentage) OVER (PARTITION BY Centre ORDER BY Month) AS Change
FROM centre_attendance_2024
JOIN centre_attendance_2023 ON centre_attendance_2024.centre_name = centre_attendance_2023.Centre AND centre_attendance_2024.month = centre_attendance_2023.Month
WHERE Attendance_Percentage - LAG(Attendance_Percentage) OVER (PARTITION BY Centre ORDER BY Month) < 0
